judg.zh: 乾：元亨，利貞。
judg.en: The Creative. Great and originating, penetrating; it furthers firm correctness.

lines.en: A hidden dragon. Do not act.
The dragon appears in the field. It furthers one to see the great person.

lines.zh: 君子終日乾乾，夕惕若，厲，无咎。
lines.en: The noble one is active all day and watchful at nightfall. Danger, but no blame.
Wavering flight over the deep. No blame.
A dragon flying in the sky. It furthers one to see the great person.
An arrogant dragon has cause to repent.

extra.en: A host of dragons appears, none as head. Good fortune.

judg.zh: 坤：元亨，利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主，利西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞，吉。
judg.en: The Receptive. Great and originating, furthering through the constancy of a mare. The noble one has somewhere to go: leading, he goes astray; following, he finds a lord. Gain friends in the southwest, lose them in the northeast. Rest in constancy — good fortune.

lines.en: Treading on hoarfrost — hard ice is coming.
Straight, square, great. Without effort, nothing is unfavorable.

lines.zh: 含章可貞。或從王事，无成有終。
lines.en: Hidden excellence, kept firm. If you serve the king, claim no success, but bring things to a close.
A tied-up sack. No blame, no praise.
A yellow lower garment. Supreme good fortune.
Dragons fight in the meadow; their blood is black and yellow.

judg.zh: 屯：元亨，利貞，勿用有攸往，利建侯。
judg.en: Difficulty at the beginning. Great and originating, furthering constancy. Do not set out anywhere. It furthers one to appoint helpers.

lines.en: Hesitation, holding back. It furthers dwelling in constancy and appointing helpers.

lines.zh: 屯如邅如，乘馬班如。匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。
lines.en: Beset and turning back, horses pulling away. Not a robber but a suitor. The maiden stays firm and does not pledge; after ten years she pledges.

lines.zh: 即鹿无虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
lines.en: Chasing deer with no forester, only deeper into the woods. The noble one reads the signs and lets go; to go on brings regret.

lines.zh: 乘馬班如，求婚媾，往吉，无不利。
lines.en: Horses pulling away. Seek the union — to go brings fortune; nothing is unfavorable.
Hoarding the bounty. In small things, constancy is fortunate; in great things, ill.
Horses pulling away; weeping tears of blood in streams.

judg.zh: 蒙：亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
judg.en: Youthful folly. Success. I do not seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. The first divination I answer; ask twice or thrice and it profanes — the profaned I do not answer. It furthers constancy.

lines.zh: 發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
lines.en: To open folly, it helps to apply discipline and remove fetters; but to go on that way brings regret.
To bear with the foolish brings fortune; to take a wife brings fortune; the son can keep the house.

lines.zh: 勿用取女；見金夫，不有躬，无攸利。
lines.en: Do not take this woman: seeing a man of gold she loses herself. Nothing furthers.
Trapped in folly. Regret.
Childlike folly. Good fortune.
Striking at folly. It does not help to play the robber; it helps to fend off robbers.

judg.zh: 需：有孚，光亨，貞吉。利涉大川。
judg.en: Waiting. With sincerity, radiant success; constancy brings fortune. It furthers crossing the great water.

lines.en: Waiting in the meadow. It helps to stay constant; no blame.
Waiting on the sand. A little talk against you; in the end, fortune.
Waiting in the mud. It invites the robbers.
Waiting in blood. Get out of the pit.
Waiting with wine and food. Constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。
lines.en: Into the pit. Three uninvited guests arrive; honor them and the end is fortunate.

judg.zh: 訟：有孚，窒。惕中吉。終凶。利見大人，不利涉大川。
judg.en: Conflict. Sincerity blocked. Caution and balance bring fortune; carried to the end, ill. It furthers seeing the great person; it does not further crossing the great water.

lines.en: Do not prolong the matter. A little talk against you; the end is fortunate.

lines.zh: 不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶，无眚。
lines.en: You cannot win the dispute; go home and withdraw. Your town of three hundred households stays free of harm.

lines.zh: 食舊德，貞厲，終吉，或從王事，无成。
lines.en: Live on old virtue. Firmness amid danger; the end is fortunate. If you serve the king, claim no success.

lines.zh: 不克訟，復即命渝，安貞吉。
lines.en: You cannot win; turn back to accept fate and change course. Rest in constancy — fortune.
To arbitrate the dispute. Supreme good fortune.

lines.zh: 或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。
lines.en: Granted a leather belt of honor — thrice torn away before the morning ends.

judg.zh: 師：貞，丈人，吉无咎。
judg.en: The Army. Constancy and a seasoned leader — good fortune, no blame.

lines.en: The army marches by discipline; without it, however good the cause, ill.

lines.zh: 在師中吉，无咎，王三錫命。
lines.en: In the midst of the army — fortune, no blame. The king thrice confers his charge.
The army may cart corpses home. Ill.
The army camps and draws back. No blame.

lines.zh: 田有禽，利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
lines.en: Game in the field; it helps to seize it, no blame. Let the eldest lead the host; if the young lead, they cart corpses. Constancy against ill.

lines.zh: 大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。
lines.en: The great ruler issues commands, founds states and families. Do not employ small men.

judg.zh: 比：吉。原筮元永貞，无咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
judg.en: Holding Together. Good fortune. Inquire again: are you great, enduring, firm? Then no blame. The restless come; those who come late meet ill.

lines.zh: 有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它吉。
lines.en: Sincerity in holding together — no blame. Sincerity brimming like a full jar; in the end other good fortune comes.
Holding together from within. Constancy brings fortune.
Holding together with the wrong people.
Holding together with those beyond. Constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 顯比，王用三驅，失前禽。邑人不誡，吉。
lines.en: Manifest union. The king hunts on three sides, letting the game before him go. The townsfolk need no warning. Good fortune.
Holding together without a head. Ill.

judg.zh: 小畜：亨。密雲不雨，自我西郊。
judg.en: Small Taming. Success. Dense clouds, no rain, from our western fields.

lines.en: Return to your own road — what blame in that? Good fortune.
Drawn back to return. Good fortune.
The cart loses its spokes; husband and wife avert their eyes.
Sincerity; blood departs, fear leaves. No blame.
Sincerity binding others; rich, and sharing with the neighbor.

lines.zh: 既雨既處，尚德載，婦貞厲。月幾望，君子征凶。
lines.en: The rain has come, things rest; virtue is carried full. For the wife, firmness amid danger. The moon nearly full; if the noble one presses on, ill.

judg.zh: 履：履虎尾，不咥人，亨。
judg.en: Treading. Treading on the tiger's tail; it does not bite. Success.

lines.en: Simple conduct. To go brings no blame.
Treading a smooth, level road. For the quiet recluse, constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。
lines.en: The one-eyed think they see, the lame think they walk; treading the tiger's tail, they are bitten. Ill. A bravo playing the great ruler.
Treading the tiger's tail with wary dread; the end is fortunate.
Resolute treading. Firmness amid danger.
Look back over your conduct and weigh the omens; if the round is complete, supreme good fortune.

judg.zh: 泰：小往大來，吉亨。
judg.en: Peace. The small departs, the great arrives. Good fortune, success.

lines.en: Pulling up thatch-grass, roots and all; to set out brings fortune.

lines.zh: 包荒，用馮河，不遐遺，朋亡，得尚于中行。
lines.en: Bearing with the wild, fording the river, not neglecting the distant, not clinging to friends — thus you walk the middle way.

lines.zh: 无平不陂，无往不復，艱貞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
lines.en: No plain without a slope, no going without return. Firm in hardship, no blame. Do not fret over sincerity; there is fortune in your food.

lines.zh: 翩翩，不富，以其鄰，不戒以孚。
lines.en: Fluttering down, not rich, yet with the neighbors — not warned, but sincere.
King Yi gives his daughter in marriage; blessing and supreme good fortune.

lines.zh: 城復于隍，勿用師。自邑告命，貞吝。
lines.en: The wall falls back into the moat. Do not use the army. Announce your will in your own town. Firmness brings regret.

judg.zh: 否：否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。
judg.en: Standstill. Obstruction by the wrong people; it does not further the noble one's constancy. The great departs, the small arrives.

lines.en: Pulling up thatch-grass, roots and all; constancy brings fortune and success.
Bearing and complying. For small men, fortune; the great one endures the standstill — and succeeds.
Bearing shame.
One acts by command; no blame. His fellows share the blessing.

lines.zh: 休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。
lines.en: The standstill wanes; for the great one, fortune. 'What if it fails, what if it fails' — so bound to a cluster of mulberry roots.
The standstill overturns; first obstruction, then joy.

judg.zh: 同人：同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子貞。
judg.en: Fellowship. Fellowship in the open. Success. It furthers crossing the great water; it furthers the noble one's constancy.

lines.en: Fellowship at the gate. No blame.
Fellowship only with the clan. Regret.

lines.zh: 伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
lines.en: Weapons hidden in the thicket, climbing the high ridge; for three years no rising.
Mounting the wall but not attacking. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 同人，先號咷而後笑。大師克相遇。
lines.en: Fellowship: first weeping and wailing, then laughter. The great armies manage to meet.
Fellowship in the meadow. No regret.

judg.zh: 大有：元亨。
judg.en: Great Possession. Supreme success.

lines.en: No dealings with harm — no blame; hold the hardship in mind and stay blameless.
A great cart for loading; somewhere to go. No blame.

lines.zh: 公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
lines.en: A duke offers tribute to the Son of Heaven; a small man could not.
He does not flaunt his wealth. No blame.
His sincerity, met in kind, with dignity. Good fortune.
Blessed from heaven. Good fortune, nothing unfavorable.

judg.zh: 謙：亨，君子有終。
judg.en: Modesty. Success. The noble one carries it through to the end.

lines.en: The modest, modest noble one; with this he crosses the great water. Good fortune.
Modesty that finds voice. Constancy brings fortune.
Toiling and modest; the noble one carries it through. Good fortune.
Nothing unfavorable in a display of modesty.

lines.zh: 不富，以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。
lines.en: Not rich, yet with the neighbors; it helps to march against the unruly. Nothing unfavorable.
Modesty that finds voice; it helps to move the army and discipline one's own towns.

judg.zh: 豫：利建侯，行師。
judg.en: Enthusiasm. It furthers appointing helpers and setting armies in motion.

lines.en: Enthusiasm that boasts aloud. Ill.
Firm as a rock; not waiting out the day. Constancy brings fortune.
Looking up for pleasure — regret. Delay brings regret.

lines.zh: 由豫，大有得。勿疑。朋盍簪。
lines.en: The source of enthusiasm; great is the gain. Do not doubt; friends gather like clasped hair.
A persistent illness, yet one lives on and does not die.
Deluded in pleasure; but if, once formed, it changes, no blame.

judg.zh: 隨：元亨利貞，无咎。
judg.en: Following. Supreme success, furthering constancy. No blame.

lines.zh: 官有渝，貞吉。出門交有功。
lines.en: The office changes; constancy brings fortune. Go out the gate and make worthy ties.
Cleaving to the little boy, you lose the grown man.

lines.zh: 系丈夫，失小子。隨有求得，利居貞。
lines.en: Cleaving to the grown man, you lose the little boy. Following, you seek and gain; it furthers dwelling in constancy.

lines.zh: 隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎。
lines.en: Following brings a catch; constancy against ill. With sincerity on the road, made clear — what blame?
Sincere toward the good. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 拘系之，乃從維之。王用亨于西山。
lines.en: Held fast and bound to it. The king makes offering on the western mountain.

judg.zh: 蠱：元亨，利涉大川。先甲三日，後甲三日。
judg.en: Work on the Decayed. Supreme success. It furthers crossing the great water. Three days before the start, three days after.

lines.zh: 幹父之蠱，有子，考无咎，厲終吉。
lines.en: Mending the father's decay; with such a son, the departed father is without blame. Danger, but the end is fortunate.
Mending the mother's decay; do not be too rigid.

lines.zh: 幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。
lines.en: Mending the father's decay; a little regret, no great blame.
Indulging the father's decay; to go on, you meet regret.
Mending the father's decay; you win praise.
Serving neither king nor lord, he holds his own concerns lofty.

judg.zh: 臨：元，亨，利，貞。至于八月有凶。
judg.en: Approach. Great, penetrating, furthering, firm. Come the eighth month, there is ill.

lines.en: Approach in concert. Constancy brings fortune.
Approach in concert. Good fortune; nothing unfavorable.

lines.zh: 甘臨，无攸利。既憂之，无咎。
lines.en: Sweet, easy approach; nothing furthers. But once you grieve over it, no blame.
Approach at its fullest. No blame.
Wise approach, fitting a great ruler. Good fortune.
Generous approach. Good fortune, no blame.

judg.zh: 觀：盥而不薦，有孚顒若。
judg.en: Contemplation. Hands washed, the offering not yet made; sincere and dignified regard.

lines.en: A boy's viewing; for the small man no blame, for the noble one regret.
Peeping through a crack; it furthers a woman's constancy.
Contemplating my own life, whether to advance or retreat.
Contemplating the glory of the realm; it furthers being the king's guest.
Contemplating my own life; the noble one is without blame.
Contemplating his life's course; the noble one is without blame.

judg.zh: 噬嗑：亨。利用獄。
judg.en: Biting Through. Success. It furthers the use of law.

lines.en: Feet in the stocks, toes hidden. No blame.
Biting through tender flesh, the nose sinks in. No blame.
Biting dried meat and meeting poison; small regret, no blame.

lines.zh: 噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。
lines.en: Biting bony dried meat and finding a metal arrow; it furthers firmness in hardship. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，无咎。
lines.en: Biting dried meat and finding yellow gold; firmness amid danger. No blame.
A cangue on the neck, the ears hidden. Ill.

judg.zh: 賁：亨。小利有攸往。
judg.en: Grace. Success. In small matters it furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: Gracing his feet; he leaves the carriage and walks.
Gracing his beard.
Graced and glistening; enduring constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。
lines.en: Graced yet plain white, a white horse like wings; not a robber but a suitor.

lines.zh: 賁于丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。
lines.en: Grace on the hill-garden; a roll of silk, small and thin. Regret, yet the end is fortunate.
White grace, plain and simple. No blame.

judg.zh: 剝：不利有攸往。
judg.en: Splitting Apart. It does not further to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: The bed is split at the legs; constancy is scorned. Ill.
The bed is split at the frame; constancy is scorned. Ill.
He splits away with them, yet no blame.
The bed is split to the skin. Ill.
A string of fish; favor for the palace women. Nothing unfavorable.

lines.zh: 碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。
lines.en: A great fruit left uneaten; the noble one gains a carriage, the small man's hut is stripped.

judg.zh: 復：亨。出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，利有攸往。
judg.en: Return. Success. Going out and in without harm; friends come, no blame. The way turns and returns — in seven days it comes back. It furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: Returning from no great distance, before regret sets in. Supreme good fortune.
A good return. Good fortune.
Returning again and again; danger, but no blame.
Walking in the middle, he returns alone.
A noble return. No regret.

lines.zh: 迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶；至于十年，不克征。
lines.en: A deluded return. Ill, with disaster and fault. Send the army and it ends in great defeat, reaching the ruler; for ten years no campaign succeeds.

judg.zh: 无妄：元亨，利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
judg.en: Innocence. Supreme success, furthering constancy. If not upright, there is fault; it does not further to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: Innocent. To go brings good fortune.

lines.zh: 不耕獲，不菑畬，則利有攸往。
lines.en: Not plowing for the harvest, not clearing for the crop — then it furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.zh: 无妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。
lines.en: Undeserved calamity: a tethered ox, taken by a passerby, is the townsman's loss.
One can stay firm. No blame.
An undeserved illness; use no medicine and there will be joy.
Innocent, yet to act now brings fault; nothing furthers.

judg.zh: 大畜：利貞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
judg.en: Great Taming. It furthers constancy. Not eating at home brings fortune. It furthers crossing the great water.

lines.en: Danger is near; it helps to halt.
The cart's axle-straps are stripped off.

lines.zh: 良馬逐，利艱貞。曰閑輿衛，利有攸往。
lines.en: Good horses in pursuit; it furthers firmness in hardship. Practice daily with cart and guard; it furthers to have somewhere to go.
A guard-board on a young ox's horns. Supreme good fortune.
The tusks of a gelded boar. Good fortune.
One attains the highway of heaven. Success.

judg.zh: 頤：貞吉。觀頤，自求口實。
judg.en: Nourishment. Constancy brings fortune. Watch what nourishes; seek your own food by your own effort.

lines.en: You leave your magic tortoise and watch me, jaws drooping. Ill.
Nourishment upside down, against the norm; turning to the hill for food. To set out, ill.

lines.zh: 拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，无攸利。
lines.en: Against nourishment; constancy against ill. For ten years do nothing; nothing furthers.

lines.zh: 顛頤，吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。
lines.en: Nourishment from above; good fortune. A tiger's fixed gaze, desire upon desire — no blame.

lines.zh: 拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。
lines.en: Against the norm; dwelling in constancy brings fortune. Do not cross the great water.
The source of nourishment; danger, yet fortune. It furthers crossing the great water.

judg.zh: 大過：棟橈，利有攸往，亨。
judg.en: Great Exceeding. The ridgepole sags. It furthers to have somewhere to go. Success.

lines.en: Spreading white rushes beneath the offering. No blame.

lines.zh: 枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。
lines.en: A withered poplar sprouts; an old man takes a young wife. Nothing unfavorable.
The ridgepole sags to breaking. Ill.
The ridgepole braced up; good fortune. But other aims bring regret.

lines.zh: 枯楊生華，老婦得士夫，无咎无譽。
lines.en: A withered poplar flowers; an old woman takes a young husband. No blame, no praise.
Wading too far, the water covers the head. Ill, but no blame.

judg.zh: 坎：習坎，有孚，維心亨，行有尚。
judg.en: The Abysmal Water. The doubled abyss. With sincerity, the heart wins through; action is honored.

lines.en: In the doubled abyss, falling into a pit within it. Ill.
The abyss holds danger; seek, and gain a little.

lines.zh: 來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
lines.en: Abyss on abyss, coming and going; danger, and resting on it; falling into the pit. Do not act.

lines.zh: 樽酒簋貳，用缶，納約自牖，終无咎。
lines.en: A jug of wine, two bowls, earthenware; simple gifts passed through the window. In the end, no blame.
The abyss not yet full, only leveling out. No blame.

lines.zh: 係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。
lines.en: Bound with cords, set among thorns; for three years finding no way out. Ill.

judg.zh: 離：利貞，亨。畜牝牛，吉。
judg.en: The Clinging Fire. It furthers constancy. Success. Tend a cow, and there is good fortune.

lines.en: Footsteps crisscross in confusion; treat it with respect and no blame.
Yellow radiance. Supreme good fortune.

lines.zh: 日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。
lines.en: The light of the setting sun; if you do not drum and sing, then comes an old man's lament. Ill.

lines.zh: 突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
lines.en: Sudden its coming — flaring up, dying down, cast away.
Tears streaming, sighing in grief. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。
lines.en: The king marches out; fine success in breaking the leaders. He takes captives but not the followers. No blame.

judg.zh: 咸：亨，利貞，取女吉。
judg.en: Influence. Success. It furthers constancy. To take a wife brings good fortune.

lines.en: Influence in the big toe.
Influence in the calves. Ill; but to stay put brings fortune.
Influence in the thighs, clinging to what follows; to go on brings regret.

lines.zh: 貞吉，悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
lines.en: Constancy brings fortune, regret vanishes. If you flit restlessly to and fro, only friends follow your thoughts.
Influence in the flesh of the back. No regret.
Influence in the jaws, cheeks, and tongue.

judg.zh: 恆：亨，无咎，利貞，利有攸往。
judg.en: Duration. Success, no blame. It furthers constancy; it furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: Seeking duration too deep, too soon; constancy against ill. Nothing furthers.
Regret vanishes.

lines.zh: 不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
lines.en: Not steady in his virtue; he meets with shame. Firmness brings regret.
A field with no game.

lines.zh: 恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
lines.en: Steady in virtue, firm; for a wife, fortune; for a man, ill.
Restless, agitated duration. Ill.

judg.zh: 遯：亨，小利貞。
judg.en: Retreat. Success. In small things it furthers constancy.

lines.en: At the tail of the retreat; danger. Do not set out anywhere.

lines.zh: 執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。
lines.en: Held fast with yellow oxhide; none can loose it.
Retreat entangled; a sickening danger. Yet to keep servants and maids brings fortune.
Retreat despite liking; for the noble one, fortune; the small man cannot.
Admirable retreat. Constancy brings fortune.
Ample, easy retreat. Nothing unfavorable.

judg.zh: 大壯：利貞。
judg.en: Great Power. It furthers constancy.

lines.en: Power in the toes; to march brings ill — of that be sure.
Constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
lines.en: The small man uses force, the noble one uses none; firmness amid danger. A ram butts the fence and snags its horns.

lines.zh: 貞吉悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。
lines.en: Constancy brings fortune, regret vanishes. The fence gives way, no snagging; power like the axle of a great cart.
Losing the ram with ease. No regret.

lines.zh: 羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。
lines.en: The ram butts the fence and can neither retreat nor advance; nothing furthers. But hold through the hardship and there is fortune.

judg.zh: 晉：康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
judg.en: Progress. A prince who brings peace, given horses in abundance, received three times in a day.

lines.zh: 晉如，摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。
lines.en: Advancing, then thrown back; constancy brings fortune. If not yet trusted, stay generous and blameless.

lines.zh: 晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。
lines.en: Advancing, yet sorrowful; constancy brings fortune. You receive great blessing from your ancestress.
All trust him; regret vanishes.
Advancing like a hoarding rat; firmness amid danger.

lines.zh: 悔亡，失得勿恤，往吉，无不利。
lines.en: Regret vanishes; do not fret over loss or gain. To go brings fortune; nothing unfavorable.

lines.zh: 晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉无咎，貞吝。
lines.en: Advancing with the horns, used only to discipline one's own town; danger, yet fortune, no blame. Firmness brings regret.

judg.zh: 明夷：利艱貞。
judg.en: Darkening of the Light. It furthers firmness in hardship.

lines.zh: 明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食，有攸往，主人有言。
lines.en: The light darkens in flight, wings drooping. The noble one on his way goes three days unfed; where he goes, the host has words against him.

lines.zh: 明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。
lines.en: The light darkens, wounded in the left thigh; saved by a strong horse. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
lines.en: The light darkens in the southern hunt; the great head is taken. Do not press too quickly for correctness.

lines.zh: 入于左腹，獲明夷之心，出于門庭。
lines.en: Entering the left belly, he grasps the heart of the darkening, and leaves gate and court.
The darkening of Jizi. It furthers constancy.

lines.zh: 不明晦，初登于天，後入于地。
lines.en: No light, only dark; first mounting to heaven, then sinking into the earth.

judg.zh: 家人：利女貞。
judg.en: The Family. It furthers a woman's constancy.

lines.en: Firm rules in the household; regret vanishes.
She takes nothing on herself but tends the food at the center. Constancy brings fortune.

lines.zh: 家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
lines.en: The family under stern rule; regret and danger, yet fortune. If wife and children only giggle, the end is regret.
She enriches the house. Great good fortune.
The king reaches the heart of his family; do not worry. To go brings fortune.
Sincerity crowned with dignity; the end is fortunate.

judg.zh: 睽：小事吉。
judg.en: Opposition. In small matters, good fortune.

lines.zh: 悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復；見惡人无咎。
lines.en: Regret vanishes. Lose your horse, do not chase it — it returns of itself. Meet even bad men, and no blame.
Meeting one's lord in a lane. No blame.

lines.zh: 見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，无初有終。
lines.en: A cart dragged back, its ox held fast, the driver branded and his nose cut off. No good start, but a good end.

lines.zh: 睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。
lines.en: Isolated in opposition, he meets a good man; they join in sincerity. Danger, but no blame.
Regret vanishes. His kin bites through the flesh; going on, what blame?

lines.zh: 睽孤，見豕負塗，載鬼一車，先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。
lines.en: Isolated in opposition, he sees a pig caked in mud, a cart full of ghosts; first he draws his bow, then lays it down — no robber but a suitor. Going on, he meets rain, and there is fortune.

judg.zh: 蹇：利西南，不利東北；利見大人，貞吉。
judg.en: Obstruction. The southwest furthers, the northeast does not. It furthers seeing the great person. Constancy brings fortune.

lines.en: Going leads to obstruction; coming back brings praise.
The king's servant meets obstruction upon obstruction — not for his own sake.
Going leads to obstruction; so he turns back.
Going leads to obstruction; coming back, he unites with others.
Amid the greatest obstruction, friends come.
Going leads to obstruction; coming back brings greatness. Good fortune. It furthers seeing the great person.

judg.zh: 解：利西南，无所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
judg.en: Deliverance. The southwest furthers. If nothing more is to be done, return brings fortune. If something is to be done, do it early — fortune.

lines.en: No blame.
In the hunt, three foxes taken and a yellow arrow found. Constancy brings fortune.
Bearing a load yet riding a carriage invites robbers. Firmness brings regret.
Free yourself from your big toe; then friends come and trust you.

lines.zh: 君子維有解，吉；有孚于小人。
lines.en: The noble one delivers himself; good fortune. Even small men are shown his sincerity.

lines.zh: 公用射隼于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。
lines.en: The duke shoots a hawk atop the high wall and takes it. Nothing unfavorable.

judg.zh: 損：有孚，元吉，无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用，二簋可用享。
judg.en: Decrease. With sincerity, supreme good fortune, no blame; one may stay firm; it furthers to have somewhere to go. And how to use it? Two bowls suffice for the offering.

lines.en: Finish your task and hurry to help; no blame. But weigh how much you give away.
It furthers constancy; to march is ill. Without decreasing yourself, you add to others.

lines.zh: 三人行，則損一人；一人行，則得其友。
lines.en: Three walking together lose one; one walking alone finds a companion.
Lessen your faults; make haste and there is joy. No blame.

lines.zh: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，元吉。
lines.en: Someone enriches him — a tortoise worth ten strings of shells, not to be refused. Supreme good fortune.

lines.zh: 弗損益之，无咎，貞吉，有攸往，得臣无家。
lines.en: Increasing others without diminishing himself; no blame, constancy brings fortune. Somewhere to go; he gains servants beyond his own house.

judg.zh: 益：利有攸往，利涉大川。
judg.en: Increase. It furthers to have somewhere to go; it furthers crossing the great water.

lines.en: It furthers doing great deeds; supreme good fortune, no blame.

lines.zh: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
lines.en: Someone enriches him — a tortoise worth ten strings of shells, not to be refused. Enduring constancy brings fortune. The king offers to God; good fortune.

lines.zh: 益之用凶事，无咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。
lines.en: Enriched even through misfortune; no blame. With sincerity, walking the middle, he reports to the duke with the jade token.

lines.zh: 中行，告公從。利用為依遷國。
lines.en: Walking the middle, he advises the duke, who follows. It furthers moving the capital.

lines.zh: 有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。
lines.en: A sincere, kind heart — no need to ask: supreme good fortune. Others sincerely honor your virtue.

lines.zh: 莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。
lines.en: None enrich him; some strike at him. His heart is set on nothing steady. Ill.

judg.zh: 夬：揚于王庭，孚號，有厲，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
judg.en: Breakthrough. Proclaim it in the king's court. A sincere outcry, and danger. Announce it in your own town. It does not further to take up arms; it furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.en: Power in the advancing toes; to go and not prevail is blame.
A wary cry; arms may come by night — do not fear.

lines.zh: 壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行，遇雨，若濡，有慍，无咎。
lines.en: Power in the cheekbones; ill. The noble one, resolute, walks alone, meets rain and is drenched, is resented — yet no blame.

lines.zh: 臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。
lines.en: Buttocks stripped of skin, walking haltingly. Led like a sheep, regret would vanish — but hearing this, he will not believe.
Weeds cleared away with resolve; walking the middle, no blame.
No cry for help; in the end, ill.

judg.zh: 姤：女壯，勿用取女。
judg.en: Coming to Meet. A bold, strong woman. Do not take her to wife.

lines.zh: 繫于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。
lines.en: Braked with a metal chock; constancy brings fortune. To go somewhere meets ill. A lean pig, sure to jump about.
Fish in the wrapper; no blame. But do not offer it to guests.

lines.zh: 臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。
lines.en: Buttocks stripped of skin, walking haltingly; danger, but no great blame.
No fish in the wrapper; ill arises.

lines.zh: 以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
lines.en: A willow shades the melon; hidden brilliance; something drops from heaven.
Meeting with the horns; regret, but no blame.

judg.zh: 萃：亨。王假有廟，利見大人，亨，利貞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
judg.en: Gathering Together. Success. The king reaches his temple. It furthers seeing the great person; success, furthering constancy. Great offerings bring fortune; it furthers to have somewhere to go.

lines.zh: 有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。
lines.en: Sincerity that fails to hold; then disorder, then gathering. Cry out, and a handful turns to laughter. Do not worry; going brings no blame.
Drawn together; good fortune, no blame. With sincerity, even a small spring offering serves.

lines.zh: 萃如，嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。
lines.en: Gathering, then sighing; nothing furthers. Going brings no blame, only small regret.
Great good fortune. No blame.

lines.zh: 萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。
lines.en: Gathering around his position; no blame. If some do not trust, be great, enduring, and firm, and regret vanishes.
Lamenting, tears and sniveling. No blame.

judg.zh: 升：元亨，用見大人，勿恤，南征吉。
judg.en: Pushing Upward. Supreme success. Seek to see the great person; do not worry. To march south brings fortune.

lines.en: Welcomed upward. Great good fortune.
With sincerity, even a small spring offering serves. No blame.
Climbing up into an empty town.
The king makes offering on Mount Qi. Good fortune, no blame.
Constancy brings fortune; mounting the stairs step by step.
Climbing in the dark; it furthers unceasing constancy.

judg.zh: 困：亨，貞，大人吉，无咎，有言不信。
judg.en: Oppression. Success. For the firm and truly great, good fortune, no blame. Words now will not be believed.

lines.zh: 臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
lines.en: Bruised on a tree-stump, entering a gloomy valley; for three years unseen.

lines.zh: 困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用享祀，征凶，无咎。
lines.en: Oppressed amid wine and food; the scarlet sash arrives. It furthers making offering. To march is ill, but no blame.

lines.zh: 困于石，據于蒺蔾，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
lines.en: Oppressed by a rock, clutching at thorns; entering his house, he does not see his wife. Ill.

lines.zh: 來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。
lines.en: Coming slowly, oppressed by a metal carriage; regret, yet an end.

lines.zh: 劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
lines.en: Nose and feet cut off, oppressed by the crimson sash; slowly there is relief. It furthers to sacrifice.

lines.zh: 困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔。有悔，征吉。
lines.en: Oppressed by creepers, on a tottering height, saying 'to move is to regret.' Repent, and to go on brings fortune.

judg.zh: 井：改邑不改井，无喪无得，往來井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。
judg.en: The Well. The town may move, the well does not. It neither loses nor gains; all come and go and draw from it. But if one all but reaches the water and the rope falls short, or the jug breaks — ill.

lines.en: A muddy well no one drinks from; an old well where not even birds come.
The well leaks to the minnows below; the jug is cracked and drains away.

lines.zh: 井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明，並受其福。
lines.en: The well cleaned but undrunk — it grieves my heart. It could be drawn; were the king wise, all would share the blessing.
The well is lined with brick. No blame.
The well is clear; its cold spring is drunk.
The well drawn from and left uncovered; with sincerity, supreme good fortune.

judg.zh: 革：巳日乃孚，元亨利貞，悔亡。
judg.en: Revolution. On the day it is done, it is believed. Supreme success, furthering constancy; regret vanishes.

lines.en: Bound fast with yellow oxhide.
When the day comes, then make the change; to march brings fortune, no blame.

lines.zh: 征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。
lines.en: To march is ill; firmness amid danger. When talk of change has come round thrice, there is trust.
Regret vanishes; with sincerity, the mandate is changed. Good fortune.
The great one changes like a tiger; even before divining, he is trusted.

lines.zh: 君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。
lines.en: The noble one changes like a leopard; small men change their faces. To march is ill; to abide firm brings fortune.

judg.zh: 鼎：元吉，亨。
judg.en: The Cauldron. Supreme good fortune. Success.

lines.zh: 鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，无咎。
lines.en: The cauldron tipped on its legs; good for pouring out the bad. Taking a concubine for her son's sake. No blame.

lines.zh: 鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
lines.en: The cauldron full of food; my rival is sick and cannot reach me. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。
lines.en: The cauldron's handles altered, its use blocked; the rich pheasant goes uneaten. But rain comes, regret wanes; the end is fortunate.

lines.zh: 鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。
lines.en: The cauldron's leg breaks, the duke's meal is spilled, its shame drenches him. Ill.
The cauldron with yellow handles and metal rings. It furthers constancy.
The cauldron with rings of jade. Great good fortune; nothing unfavorable.

judg.zh: 震：亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞。震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
judg.en: The Arousing Thunder. Success. Thunder comes with terror, then laughter and talk. It startles for a hundred li, yet he does not drop the sacrificial ladle and wine.

lines.zh: 震來虩虩，後笑言啞啞，吉。
lines.en: Thunder comes with terror, then laughter and talk. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。
lines.en: Thunder comes with danger; a hundred thousand in wealth lost. Climb the nine hills; do not chase it — in seven days you regain it.
Thunder leaves him dazed; but if it moves him to act, no fault.
Thunder sinks into the mud.
Thunder coming and going, all danger; but nothing is lost — there is work to do.

lines.zh: 震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，无咎。婚媾有言。
lines.en: Thunder leaves him trembling, glancing about; to go on is ill. But if it strikes not himself but his neighbor, no blame — though kin may murmur.

judg.zh: 艮：艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，无咎。
judg.en: Keeping Still, Mountain. Stillness in the back, till the self is forgotten; walking the courtyard, seeing no one there. No blame.

lines.en: Stillness in the toes. No blame; it furthers enduring constancy.

lines.zh: 艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。
lines.en: Stillness in the calves; he cannot rescue the one he follows, and his heart is uneasy.
Stillness at the waist, wrenching the spine; danger smolders in the heart.
Stillness in the trunk. No blame.
Stillness in the jaws; words in order. Regret vanishes.
Wholehearted stillness. Good fortune.

judg.zh: 漸：女歸吉，利貞。
judg.en: Development. The maiden marries; good fortune. It furthers constancy.

lines.zh: 鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，无咎。
lines.en: Wild geese draw near the shore; the young one in danger, spoken against, yet no blame.
Wild geese draw near the rock; eating and drinking in ease and joy. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶；利禦寇。
lines.en: Wild geese draw near the plateau; the husband marches and does not return, the wife conceives but does not raise the child. Ill; it helps to fend off robbers.

lines.zh: 鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。
lines.en: Wild geese draw near the trees; perhaps a flat branch to rest on. No blame.

lines.zh: 鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
lines.en: Wild geese draw near the ridge; for three years the wife does not conceive, yet in the end nothing prevails against her. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。
lines.en: Wild geese draw near the heights; their feathers serve for the sacred dance. Good fortune.

judg.zh: 歸妹：征凶，无攸利。
judg.en: The Marrying Maiden. To act is ill; nothing furthers.

lines.en: The maiden married as a junior bride; the lame can still tread. To go on brings fortune.
One-eyed, yet able to see; it furthers the constancy of a solitary one.
The maiden waiting to marry; she returns and goes as a junior bride.
The maiden lets the term pass; a late marriage will have its time.

lines.zh: 帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。
lines.en: King Yi gives his daughter in marriage; her sleeves are less fine than her bridesmaid's. The moon nearly full. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 女承筐无實，士刲羊无血，无攸利。
lines.en: The woman holds a basket with nothing in it; the man stabs the sheep, no blood flows. Nothing furthers.

judg.zh: 豐：亨，王假之，勿憂，宜日中。
judg.en: Abundance. Success. The king attains it; do not grieve — be like the sun at noon.

lines.zh: 遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。
lines.en: Meeting his match; though ten days pass, no blame. To go is honored.

lines.zh: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。
lines.en: The screen so thick that at noon he sees the Dipper; to go now draws suspicion. Let sincerity break forth. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，无咎。
lines.en: The curtain so thick that at noon he sees the small stars; he breaks his right arm. No blame.

lines.zh: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
lines.en: The screen so thick that at noon he sees the Dipper; he meets his equal. Good fortune.
Brilliant men come; there is blessing and praise. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 豐其屋，蔀其家，闚其戶，闃其无人，三歲不覿，凶。
lines.en: His house made grand but screens off his home; peering in the door, all is still, no one there; for three years unseen. Ill.

judg.zh: 旅：小亨，旅貞吉。
judg.en: The Wanderer. Small success. For the wanderer, constancy brings fortune.

lines.en: The wanderer, petty and mean — thus he draws disaster on himself.

lines.zh: 旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
lines.en: The wanderer reaches an inn, holds his goods, and gains a young servant's loyalty.

lines.zh: 旅焚其次，喪其童僕，貞厲。
lines.en: The wanderer's inn burns down; he loses his young servant. Firmness amid danger.

lines.zh: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
lines.en: The wanderer at a resting place, with goods and an axe; yet my heart is uneasy.
Shooting a pheasant, one arrow lost; in the end, praise and appointment.

lines.zh: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。
lines.en: The bird's nest burns; the wanderer first laughs, then wails. He loses the ox too easily. Ill.

judg.zh: 巽：小亨，利攸往，利見大人。
judg.en: The Gentle Wind. Small success. It furthers having somewhere to go; it furthers seeing the great person.

lines.en: Advancing and retreating; it furthers the constancy of a warrior.

lines.zh: 巽在床下，用史巫紛若，吉，无咎。
lines.en: Penetrating beneath the bed; using scribes and shamans in great number. Good fortune, no blame.
Penetrating over and over. Regret.
Regret vanishes; the hunt takes game of three kinds.

lines.zh: 貞吉悔亡，无不利。无初有終，先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
lines.en: Constancy brings fortune, regret vanishes; nothing unfavorable. No good start, but a good end. Three days before the turning, three days after. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 巽在床下，喪其資斧，貞凶。
lines.en: Penetrating beneath the bed; he loses his goods and his axe. Firmness against ill.

judg.zh: 兌：亨，利貞。
judg.en: The Joyous Lake. Success. It furthers constancy.

lines.en: The joy of harmony. Good fortune.
The joy of sincerity; good fortune, regret vanishes.
Coming to court pleasure. Ill.
Weighing where to take joy, not yet at rest; keep from harm and there is gladness.
Trusting in what would erode you; there is danger.
Alluring others to pleasure.

judg.zh: 渙：亨。王假有廟，利涉大川，利貞。
judg.en: Dispersion. Success. The king reaches his temple. It furthers crossing the great water; it furthers constancy.

lines.en: Rescue with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.
Amid dispersion, he hurries to his support; regret vanishes.
He disperses his own self-regard. No regret.

lines.zh: 渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
lines.en: He disperses the factions; supreme good fortune. From dispersion, a gathering like a hill — beyond ordinary thought.

lines.zh: 渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。
lines.en: Dispersing, he issues his great decree like sweat; he scatters the royal stores. No blame.
He disperses its blood, keeps far from harm, and departs. No blame.

judg.zh: 節：亨。苦節，不可貞。
judg.en: Limitation. Success. But galling limits cannot be kept.

lines.en: Not leaving the inner court. No blame.
Not leaving the outer gate. Ill.
One who keeps no measure will come to lament; but the blame is his own.
Contented in one's limits. Success.
Sweet limitation; good fortune. To go on is honored.
Galling limitation; firmness against ill. Yet regret vanishes.

judg.zh: 中孚：豚魚吉，利涉大川，利貞。
judg.en: Inner Truth. It reaches even pigs and fishes; good fortune. It furthers crossing the great water; it furthers constancy.

lines.en: Prepared, there is fortune; but a hidden aim leaves no peace.

lines.zh: 鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
lines.en: A crane calls in the shade, its young answer. 'I have a good cup; I will share it with you.'

lines.zh: 得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。
lines.en: Facing his match: now drumming, now stopping, now weeping, now singing.
The moon nearly full; the team-mate horse is gone. No blame.
Sincerity that binds others fast. No blame.
A cock's crow rising to heaven. Firmness against ill.

judg.zh: 小過：亨，利貞，可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上，宜下，大吉。
judg.en: Small Exceeding. Success; it furthers constancy. In small things one may act, not in great. The flying bird leaves its cry — better to go down than up. Great good fortune.

lines.en: A bird flying too high. Ill.

lines.zh: 過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；无咎。
lines.en: Passing the grandfather, he meets the grandmother; not reaching the ruler, he meets the minister. No blame.
Not going too far, but on guard; if he lets down, someone strikes him. Ill.

lines.zh: 无咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。
lines.en: No blame; without excess he meets the moment. Going on is dangerous — be wary; do not hold rigidly firm forever.

lines.zh: 密雲不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。
lines.en: Dense clouds, no rain, from our western fields; the duke shoots and takes the game in the cave.

lines.zh: 弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。
lines.en: Not meeting it but overshooting; the flying bird strays off. Ill — this is called calamity and self-made harm.

judg.zh: 既濟：亨，小利貞，初吉終亂。
judg.en: After Completion. Success in small things; it furthers constancy. Fortunate at the start, disordered at the end.

lines.en: He brakes the wheel; the fox wets its tail. No blame.
The wife loses her carriage-screen; do not chase it — in seven days she finds it.

lines.zh: 高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
lines.en: Gaozong attacks the Devil's Country; in three years he subdues it. Do not employ small men.
Fine clothes turn to rags; be on guard all day long.

lines.zh: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。
lines.en: The eastern neighbor slays an ox; less worthy than the western neighbor's small offering, which truly receives the blessing.
He wets his head. Danger.

judg.zh: 未濟：亨，小狐汔濟，濡其尾，无攸利。
judg.en: Before Completion. Success. The little fox, almost across, wets its tail; nothing furthers.

lines.en: He wets his tail. Regret.
He brakes the wheel. Constancy brings fortune.
Not yet across; to march is ill, yet it furthers crossing the great water.

lines.zh: 貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。
lines.en: Constancy brings fortune, regret vanishes. With thunder he attacks the Devil's Country; in three years, reward from the great kingdom.

lines.zh: 貞吉，无悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。
lines.en: Constancy brings fortune, no regret. The light of the noble one, filled with sincerity. Good fortune.

lines.zh: 有孚于飲酒，无咎，濡其首，有孚失是。
lines.en: Sincerity in drinking wine; no blame. But wet your head, and even sincerity loses its measure.
